# GitHub Actions Badge

Add this to the top of your README.md to show build status:

## Badge Markdown

Replace `YOUR_USERNAME` and `YOUR_REPO` with your actual GitHub username and repository name:

```markdown
[![Multi-Platform Build](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/actions/workflows/build.yml)
```

## Example

If your GitHub is `joshua-9402/cpet-140-final-project`:

```markdown
[![Multi-Platform Build](https://github.com/joshua-9402/cpet-140-final-project/actions/workflows/build.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/joshua-9402/cpet-140-final-project/actions/workflows/build.yml)
```

## Where to Place It

Add it near the top of your README.md, typically:
- Right after the project title
- In a "badges" section with other status badges
- Before the description/overview

## What It Shows

- **Green checkmark**: All builds passing
- **Red X**: One or more builds failing
- **Yellow circle**: Builds in progress
- **Gray**: No builds yet

Click the badge to see detailed build logs.
